text: You could consider dividing your 30 minutes into three parts. Spend five minutes separating the papers from the cables, which should give you a good starting point. Then, use the next 15 minutes to sort the papers into three groups: keep, discard, and undecided. This will help you make some progress on organizing your papers. Finally, dedicate the last 10 minutes to gathering the cables into one place. This plan should help you make the most of your 30 minutes, but feel free to adjust it if you find it's not working for you. It's also a good idea to leave the undecided papers together for now, rather than getting bogged down in making decisions about them.
